scope: One semantic classification review of the current MI article against the frozen WHO ICD-11 MMS 2026-01 denominator; no new medical fact review, no production writes and no duplicated content.

read_locations.purpose: Chapter 11 inherited exclusions and coded-elsewhere entries
Ischaemic/acute ischaemic parent blocks; acute coronary syndrome inclusion and angina siblings
BA41 parent definition/exclusions, all three BA41 children, BA42 definition/inclusions/exclusion and BA42.0

official_sources_actually_read.findings: BA41.0 supplies an ECG/ST-elevation definition; BA41.1 and BA41.Z have no additional printed definition or separate inclusion/exclusion list on the page and inherit BA41/Chapter 11 context. Printed BA41 explicitly excludes BA42, BA50, BA60 and post-MI syndrome. BA42 describes extension/recurrent infarction within 28 days and has its own three leaf categories. No BA41.Y leaf exists in the frozen table.

official_sources_actually_read.release_note: Current official web Reference Guide; conventions corroborate residual semantics, while category membership remains pinned to the 2026-01 snapshot.
official_sources_actually_read.findings: Exclusions mark categories classified elsewhere and may be inherited from a chapter/group. Inclusion terms are not an exhaustive subclassification. Unspecified applies when source documentation lacks the necessary more specific information; it is not the same as uncertain diagnosis or a general educational heading.

official_text_caveat.locator: WHO 2026-01 print PDF page 772, BA41 last descriptive sentence before Exclusions
official_text_caveat.observation: The BA41 description also contains a sentence about infarction within 28 days of a previous infarction, overlapping the adjacent BA42 definition, while the explicit BA41 exclusion directs subsequent MI to BA42.
official_text_caveat.handling: Preserved as an observed classification-text inconsistency; no silent correction or clinical coding instruction is invented. This educational mapping obeys the explicit exclusion and never counts BA42 through BA41. Patient-level recurrent-event coding is outside this review.

method.rule: Assess explanatory public education across each eligible leaf, using shared content plus genuinely type-specific conditions. Entire leaf means applicable education for the classified condition, not every patient receiving every drug or an exhaustive clinical practice guideline.
method.shared_content: One canonical article can serve multiple leaf categories after explicit semantic assignment; absence of duplicate pages is not a content gap.
method.residual_handling: BA41.Z is assessed independently from its title. The common claims require no ST assignment, and the diagnosis/treatment passages explain why specific branches depend on additional findings. This report explicitly supplies the formerly missing category-to-claim assignment.
method.inherited_medical_evidence: The 14-section/90-claim accepted ledger is inherited and hash-bound; no unsupported claim is upgraded and clinician sign-off remains false.
method.official_browser_attempt: web.open returned only the WHO browser shell and direct ICD API returned HTTP 401; the official versioned print ZIP and official reference HTML were then fetched and actually read. Third-party search results were not used for a classification decision.

category_reviews.scope: Acute myocardial infarction with ST elevation, interpreted within BA41 parent and Chapter 11 exclusions.
category_reviews.official_locator: WHO 2026-01 print PDF page 772 (printed page 770), BA41.0; BA41 parent definition/exclusions; Chapter 11 page 768 (printed page 766).
category_reviews.rationale: Current bilingual article explicitly explains ST-elevation versus non-ST-elevation diagnosis and eligible STEMI reperfusion/thrombolysis, and the adjudicated shared sections supply all 14 public-education dimensions. Common causes are not asserted as exclusive and treatment remains conditional. The entire frozen acute-STEMI leaf can be served by this combined article; no duplicate article or specialist ECG/dose protocol is required by the content standard.

section_matrix.assessment: 定义缺血导致的心肌损伤/坏死、冠状动脉供血、表现及与骤停的关系；未把某一ECG分型或某一病因说成全部心梗。
斑块血栓被明确写为常见机制，同时列出痉挛、血管壁撕裂；可改变/不可改变风险与年轻、无传统风险仍可能发作的边界均可用于三类。无需将所有较少见病因逐个写成专科指南才满足公众病因维度。
急救触发来自可识别的症状及失去反应/异常呼吸，不依赖读者已知ST分型；症状轻或波动也报告，适用于三类。
急性疑似事件与恢复期复诊分开；地区化阿司匹林条件、药物/出血告知及活动恢复属于共用就医过程。再发症状的急救提示只是一条升级行动，不据此认领BA42。
症状、ECG、肌钙蛋白及其局限、重复检测、超声和造影构成共用诊断解释；diagnosis-5提供分型关系与NSTEMI不等于轻症的具体区分。现行公众标准不要求列出导联、电压或99百分位诊断算法。

claim_roles.diagnosis-5: Direct subtype identification plus comparison with NSTEMI; no lay ECG self-diagnosis.

section_matrix.assessment: 反流/胸壁问题、稳定/不稳定心绞痛、夹层及肺栓塞解释相似处和急诊排除边界；任何ECG分型都不能凭症状自行排除，未将这些鉴别诊断计入MI覆盖。
目标、PCI/支架及搭桥机制共用；STEMI溶栓严格附适应条件与出血风险，NSTEMI另有抗栓、风险导向造影/介入分支。条件分支保留，无一条要求所有类别都接受同一治疗。

claim_roles.branch_assignment: STEMI branch applies only to eligible cases; NSTEMI branch is contrastive education.

section_matrix.assessment: 药物类别的作用、代表药、出血/肌痛/咳嗽/肾功能/呼吸风险及监测是共用教育；联合治疗、疗程、支架和已开药等适用条件保留，不声称每位读者都应使用每一种药。
康复期风险管理及食物不能处理急性堵塞的界线共用；糖尿病和肾病建议仅在合并疾病时适用，不由ST分型决定。
按康复计划活动、停止活动/升级急救的界线、症状记录、药单与可执行性属于心梗后共用护理，不以已知ST分型作为前提。
年龄、性别、糖尿病的表现差异共用；妊娠/产后句属于相关人群教育，因Chapter 11将孕产并发疾病另置Chapter 18/JB64.4，不用这些句子证明新增孕产分类覆盖。
心肌损伤、治疗时机及原有健康影响恢复，复诊关注功能/症状/血压/血脂/用药与肾功能，适用于三类。再发风险告知不是BA42的独立介绍。
泵血、电活动、心衰、休克及心律失常作为原病的风险与升级行动解释；不等于对BA60及其叶类、心衰或骤停完成独立14维覆盖。
首次预防与心梗后防复发分开，风险管理和避免自行长期阿司匹林的界线共用；不能保证不发作，亦不把防复发段当作再次梗死类别文章。

category_reviews.scope: Acute myocardial infarction established as the condition, with insufficient source-record detail to select the STEMI or NSTEMI child; not a generic chest-pain/suspected-MI category, and not a collective label for all MI.
category_reviews.official_locator: WHO 2026-01 print PDF page 772 (printed page 770), BA41.Z; BA41 parent definition/exclusions; Chapter 11 page 768 (printed page 766). WHO Reference Guide 2.7.3.2 and 2.7.5 determine residual meaning.
category_reviews.rationale: The reviewed residual scope is established acute MI without sufficient documented ST-subtype detail, as distinguished from unconfirmed disease. All common MI education remains applicable without assuming a subtype; diagnosis-5 explains the distinction and treatment-2b/2c/3 remain conditional comparisons instead of a universal regimen. This is an explicit claim-level residual-scope adjudication, not an inference from the umbrella title. Under the existing public-education standard no separate code-definition paragraph or duplicate article is required to make the educational content applicable.

adjudication.exclusions_considered: WHO 2026-01 BA41 excludes BA42 subsequent MI, BA50 old MI, BA60 current post-MI complications and BA60.0 post-MI syndrome. Chapter 11 exclusions/coded-elsewhere notes include perinatal, infectious, pregnancy/puerperal (including JB64.4), developmental, endocrine/metabolic, injury and other separately classified conditions. Article recurrence warnings, long-term prevention, complication discussion and pregnancy context do not claim those categories. STEMI/NSTEMI comparisons do not make either subtype the other; BA41.Z means insufficient type documentation, not unconfirmed MI. No parent, sibling, exclusion, extension code or future-release subdivision is counted.

not_covered_by_this_article_review.reason: Official is_leaf=false. Reviewing an umbrella does not add a denominator member.

The article warns about recurrence and prevention but does not explain the defining extension/recurrent event within 28 days or the assessment of a new event in the context of recent MI. This is an actual category-specific knowledge gap, not another pending-label loop.
not_covered_by_this_article_review.completion_condition: Add a concise, supported subsequent-MI explanation of its distinct recent-event context and how recurrence is assessed after a prior infarction, keep STEMI/NSTEMI/unspecified branches explicit, then assign existing shared dimensions with independently checked claim evidence. A separate duplicate 14-section article is not inherently required.

not_covered_by_this_article_review.reason: Follow-up, complication and pregnancy passages provide context within the acute article; they do not constitute independent category coverage.

completion_conditions.acute_leaf_classification: This report supplies the required semantic adjudications for BA41.0, BA41.1 and BA41.Z. No new article text or clinical-source pass is required for these three at the current public-education standard.
completion_conditions.integration: Replace only the current three MI partial/pending mapping records with the provided hash-bound confirmed proposals, then run the existing ICD/editorial consistency checks. Do not change medical-review state.
completion_conditions.invalidation: Any change to content_hash, the frozen release/leaf set, relevant exclusion semantics, or failed editorial qualification requires the affected mapping/evidence to be reconsidered.

validation.frozen_snapshot: load_icd re-parsed and validated official ZIP, rules and complete catalog
validation.proposal_check: Ran coverage_icd with proposals in memory; did not edit mappings or write generated coverage outputs.

rights: Official titles, codes, URIs and source hashes are retained; assessments are clearly identified project additions. The report uses original paraphrases and precise locations, without redistributing source full text. WHO ICD-11 attribution and CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO remain in data/icd/README.md.
stop: One evidence-bearing classification review complete. No serial rereview is requested; parent may integrate the concrete proposals and verify consistency.
